page.overview:
Who is M'Fast Fong?

M'Fast FongRev-N-Go Racing Tractor|occupation=Piston Cup racer for Rev-N-Go|gender=Male|appear=Cars 3}}

M Fast Fong joined the Rev-N-Go racing team in the Piston Cup Racing Series in the 2017 season replacing the previous racer. He competed in the Florida 500. He started in the back of the pack and stayed around there. He was later seen going into the pits after Cam Spinner caused a crash.
